max_tire.note: Reported to fit with no rubbing. 265/70R18 tends to touch plastics at full lock. On 17s, 275/65R17 shows only a slight liner rub at full turn.
Needs new upper control arms, the right wheel offset, a body mount chop, fender liners removed, pinch welds hammered down and an aftermarket front bumper for extra caster.

items.title: Vehicle stability control too slow
items.summary: After Consumer Reports' 'Don't Buy' rating, trucks built Nov 16, 2009 to Apr 8, 2010 got a VSC reprogram to stop sideways skids in sharp, fast turns.

items.title: Takata front airbag inflators (replacement inflators)
items.summary: Inflators fitted under an earlier Takata recall used the same design and may rupture. Dealers replace them again.

items.title: Takata front passenger airbag inflator
items.summary: Zone-based Takata inflator replacement that covers GX 460s by state of registration.

items.title: Low-pressure fuel pump
items.summary: The fuel pump may fail, causing a stall. Dealers fit a new pump.

items.title: Low-pressure fuel pump (expansion)
items.summary: Same pump failure, on later trucks. Dealers fit an improved pump assembly.

items.title: Load-capacity modification label
items.summary: Incorrect load-carrying-capacity labels. Dealers supply corrected labels.

tsbs.title: Air injection pump and air switching valve (check-engine light)
tsbs.summary: Covered moisture-damaged secondary-air parts on 2010–2013 trucks for 10 years from first use, regardless of mileage, so most coverage has now run out.

timeline.change: Launch with the 1UR-FE 4.6 V8 (301 hp), six-speed automatic and standard KDSS. In April 2010, Consumer Reports' 'Don't Buy' label led to a VSC software recall, and the label was lifted on May 7.
Secondary air-injection pump and valve failures are common. Confirm the parts were replaced under program ZLH.
First facelift: spindle grille, LED headlamps and LED DRLs, with a US price cut of $4,750. The turning circle grows from 38.1 to 41.4 ft.
Second-row captain's chairs with the Luxury package.
Second facelift. New Off-Road package with Crawl Control, Multi-Terrain Select, a transmission cooler, a fuel-tank protector and Multi-Terrain Monitor. Safety System+ is standard.
New infotainment with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto plus a redesigned dash. Black Line edition.
Final year. Eminent White Pearl added.

identify.intro: Lexus changed the GX 460 very little mechanically over 14 years, so trim, package and facelift details matter more than the badge.

items.head: VIN
items.body: US trucks start JTJ and carry 7FX in positions 6–8. NHTSA's vPIC decoder reads the series as URJ150L, the engine as the 1UR-FE and the plant as Tahara, Japan. The 10th character is the model year (A = 2010 through P = 2023).

items.head: Off-Road package (2020+)
items.body: Crawl Control and Multi-Terrain Select switches, a 360-degree camera, a transmission cooler and a fuel-tank protector. 2010–2019 trucks can be retrofitted with Crawl Control and MTS.

items.head: Rear air (RAHC) and AVS
items.body: Upper trims have rear height control air suspension and Adaptive Variable Suspension. KDSS is standard on every US GX 460.

items.head: Facelift generation
items.body: 2010–2013: original grille. 2014–2019: first spindle grille and LED headlamps. 2020–2023: angular spindle and triple-beam LEDs.

items.head: Black Line
items.body: A 2022 cosmetic package that couldn't be ordered with some luxury features such as Mark Levinson audio.

values.intro: Early trucks are the GX bargain, and late low-mile trucks and Black Lines hold close to new-car money.

values.note: Based on 30 Bring a Trailer GX 460 sales from January 2025 to October 2026, which ranged from $10,750 to $64,000 with a median of about $26,000. The top results were 2022–2023 trucks and a 2,800-mile 2017.
